-- blvcb333mby85gyrnf5nkpqangmdnbiz-src/a.lua --
local b = import "b.lua"

local x = {
  offset = 3,
}
return setmetatable(x, {
  -- Accessing each number key calls the b function.
  __index = function(_, k)
    local n = tonumber(k)
    if n then
      return b(n)
    else
      return nil
    end
  end,
})
-- blvcb333mby85gyrnf5nkpqangmdnbiz-src/b.lua --
return function (x)
  -- Importing inside a function
  -- called after the module is imported
  -- breaks the cycle.
  local a = import "a.lua"
  return x + a.offset
end
